Academic Programs and Pathways

Degrees and Certificates

Healthcare Management and Leadership, BAS, Healthcare Management General Concentration

Healthcare Management and Leadership, Healthcare Management General Concentration, BAS

The General Healthcare Concentration of the Healthcare Management and Leadership Bachelor of Applied Science degree is designed to meet the career advancement needs of indiviuals with business or healthcare preparation and experience. This career-oriented degree prepares graduates to compete for jobs that require knowledge of the healthcare system as well as supervisory and management skills.

Visit Program Website

Program Information

                Bachelor Degree

                Degree
                Bachelor of Applied Science

                                  Duration

Healthcare Management & Leadership

Course Maps

A course map is a quick guide to help students figure out which courses to take each quarter. Course maps were written by BC faculty, who have used their expertise to recommend specific courses students can take to achieve their academic or career goals. Students should meet with an advisor to learn more.

Healthcare Management General Concentration, BAS

Courses & Requirements

The course catalog is a great place to find detailed information on this program.

Sample Courses

Economics of Healthcare

Finance and Accounting for Healthcare Managers

Human Resources Management in Healthcare

Marketing in Healthcare Environment

Biomedical Ethics: Theory and Practice

Program Catalog Page

          Points of Pride

Value for Your Investment

This program is ranked as the top affordable healthcare management program in the United States. 

Browse Rankings

Fast-Growing Field

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics projects a 28% increase in job growth from 2021-2031 - "much faster than average."

See Bureau of Labor Statistics stats

Flexible Schedule

Part-time and full-time options are available, including a 100% online curriculum.

          Featured Faculty

          View HCML Faculty Page

Shana Chung

Program Chair

Shana Chung received her Bachelor’s degree from Harvard and her Master’s in Public Health and Juris Doctor degrees from the University of California. She practiced law for 10+ years. She teaches a variety of HSEWI courses, including Healthcare Legal and Regulatory Aspects, Human Resources Management, Field Studies, and Capstone Projects.

                See Shana Chung's Full Bio

Daron Vchulek

Faculty

Daron Vchulek is a healthcare administration professional with over 20 years of experience in healthcare operations, practice management, diagnostic imaging, laboratory, sleep medicine, physical therapy, development, and ancillary clinical operations. He is accomplished in structuring and negotiating advantageous terms for supplies and services. 

                See Daron Vchulek's Bio Page

Stacy Woodruff

Faculty

Stacy Woodruff earned her Bachelor’s in Business/Public Administration, Master of Education in Higher Education Leadership, and is earning a Ph.D. in Health Science with concentration in Public Health. She worked in the healthcare setting for over seven years as a medical auditor/compliance and clinical manager.

                See Stacy Woodruff's Bio Page

          Related Programs

          All Programs

Health Sciences

Healthcare Management and Leadership Certificate of Completion

Certificate

The Healthcare Management and Leadership certificate of completion is for students and working professionals who wish to develop leadership skills and gain essential knowledge of the business and administrative functions of healthcare. This certificate is designed to allow students to select three courses (15 credits total) from the HCML core curriculum that best fit their experience and goals. Courses may be offered in on-ground, online, or hybrid formats.

Health Sciences

Business

Healthcare Management and Leadership, Radiation and Imaging Management Concentration, BAS

Bachelor Degree

The Radiation and Imaging Management Concentration of the Healthcare Management and Leadership Bachelor of Applied Science degree prepares students to advance their healthcare careers with supervisory and management skills. You’ll learn leadership skills, administrative processes, and legal issues unique to the radiation and imaging industry. Students choosing this concentration are typically professionals working in radiologic technology, nuclear medicine, or radiation therapy.
